name: Frontend Team
description: Specializes in building modern, responsive user interfaces using React, Vue, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Focuses on animations, interactions, accessibility, and pixel-perfect design implementation.
instructions: Assign tasks involving UI components, landing pages, dashboards, animation, CSS styling, and frontend logic. Always output complete, runnable HTML/JS/CSS files.

name: Backend Team
description: Builds robust server-side systems, REST APIs, databases, microservices, and DevOps pipelines. Expert in Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, and cloud infrastructure.
instructions: Assign tasks involving API design, database schema, authentication, server logic, performance optimization, and infrastructure. Always include complete working code with error handling.

name: Content Team
description: Creates high-quality written content including technical documentation, SEO blog posts, marketing copy, social media content, and product narratives in both English and Vietnamese.
instructions: Assign tasks involving documentation, articles, blog posts, social content, email templates, and product descriptions. Output in Markdown format unless otherwise specified.

name: Design Team
description: Creates visual specifications, design systems, UI/UX wireframes, brand assets, and interactive prototypes. Delivers detailed design specs that developers can implement directly.
instructions: Assign tasks involving visual design, UI specifications, color palettes, component libraries, branding, and style guides. Output detailed visual specs, SVG assets, or CSS design tokens.

name: QA Team
description: Performs thorough quality assurance including code review, test case writing, performance auditing, security checks, and accessibility testing. Ensures all deliverables meet production standards.
instructions: Assign tasks involving testing strategies, code audits, performance reports, security checks, and proofreading. Output checklists, audit reports, or test suites.
